content:
The **Unstoppable Monster** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

## Background[edit]

It is currently available as a plan from Daily Ops, as one of the daily rewards introduced in the *Locked & Loaded* update.

It was formerly available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Succumb to depravity" in Survival mode from June 4–10, 2019, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update. The challenge ran again from July 23–30, 2019.

## Gameplay[edit]

The gauntlet is made up of three deathclaw claws with a simple handhold and a cushioned brace to go around the wearer's wrist. This three-star unique legendary weapon combines 3 legendary effects:

- Bloodied: Increased damage the lower the player character's health is
- Major modifier: +40% more power attack damage
- Minor modifier: Take -40% less damage while executing a power attack

This weapon cannot be used or equipped while wearing Power Armor.

- ![Daily Ops Daily Ops](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/7/74/FO76_ui_dailyops_team.png/14px-FO76_ui_dailyops_team.png) The plan for it is available as a rare reward from Daily Ops, introduced in the *Locked & Loaded* update.
- ![Limited-Time Limited-Time](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e1/Icon_limitedtime.png/14px-Icon_limitedtime.png) The Unstoppable Monster was a reward for completing the "Succumb to depravity" weekly challenge in Survival mode. The requirements were as follows: 
 - Kill a human-like creature with a melee weapon.
 - Cook a meal while intoxicated.
 - Claim a workshop while mutated.
 - Eat raw meat.
 - Kill a critter while starving.
